title: Composing two affine bounds in [0,∞] (recombination of the induction constants, Simon 8.5.10, proof of (8))
statement: Let b, c, c', k, δ ∈ ℝ and X, Y, M ∈ [0,∞] with b ≥ 0, c ≥ 0, k ≥ 0, δ² ≤ 1, b + c + bc ≤ c' and (1 + b)c + k ≤ c'. If X ≤ ofReal(1 + bδ²)·Y + ofReal(kδ²) and Y ≤ ofReal(1 + cδ²)·M + ofReal(cδ²), then X ≤ ofReal(1 + c'δ²)·M + ofReal(c'δ²). (M = ∞ is allowed.)
lean_statement: ∀ (b c c' k δ : ℝ) (X Y M : ℝ≥0∞), 0 ≤ b → 0 ≤ c → 0 ≤ k → δ ^ 2 ≤ 1 → b + c + b * c ≤ c' → (1 + b) * c + k ≤ c' → X ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + b * δ ^ 2) * Y + ENNReal.ofReal (k * δ ^ 2) → Y ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + c * δ ^ 2) * M + ENNReal.ofReal (c * δ ^ 2) → X ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + c' * δ ^ 2) * M + ENNReal.ofReal (c' * δ ^ 2)
